reading.title: Payments in Lieu of Taxes (“PILOT”) Agreement for Queens Park Plaza Apartments

signatures.party: COUNTY COUNCIL OF PRINCE GEORGE'S COUNTY, MARYLAND

candidates.quote: WHEREAS, the Owner proposes to acquire and renovate a ninety four (94) unit garden style apartment community, known as Queens Park Plaza, a portion of which will provide housing for fifty seven (57) low-income to moderate-income residents, located one half (1/2) mile from the West Hyattsville Metro rail transit station along the Yellow Line, at 2500 Queens Chapel Road, Hyattsville, Maryland 20782, as more particularly described in Exhibit A, attached hereto and herein incorporated by reference (“Property”); and
candidates.wording: will provide housing for fifty seven (57) low-income to moderate-income residents

candidates.quote: (a)(2)(iv)(2) enters into an agreement with the governing body of Prince George's County to allow the entire property or the portion of the property that was maintained for lower income persons to remain as housing for lower income persons for a term of at least 5 years; and
candidates.wording: for a term of at least 5 years

candidates.quote: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: A ninety four (94) unit garden style apartment community acquired in March 2023 by Queens Park Plaza MD LLC.
candidates.wording: A ninety four (94) unit garden style apartment community

candidates.quote: Ownership proposes to restrict rents for fifty seven (57) of the units for at least fifteen (15) years.
candidates.wording: restrict rents for fifty seven (57) of the units

candidates.quote: Ownership proposes to restrict rents for fifty seven (57) of the units for at least fifteen (15) years.
AFFORDABILITY:   40% or less of the AMI: 5 units
50% or less of the AMI:  19 units
60% or less of the AMI:  33 units

Bensahel Capital and Enrst Equities (the “Developer”) propose to restrict rent levels for fifty seven (57) of the ninety four (94) rental units at Queens Park Plaza Apartments (the “Project”) to serve households with incomes at forty percent (40%), fifty percent (50%) and sixty percent (60%) of the Area Median Income (“AMI”) for a period of at least fifteen (15) years.

candidates.quote: The Developer is applying for a Prince George’s County payment in lieu of taxes (“PILOT”) since this subsidy will allow sixty percent (60%) of the Project’s units (57 of the 94 units) to be income - and rent-restricted and ensure the Project is able to adequately service its debt and equity capital.
candidates.wording: Prince George’s County payment in lieu of taxes (“PILOT”)

candidates.quote: The Prince George’s County subsidy for the Project consists of a Prince George’s County Payment in lieu of T axes (“PILOT”) and will preserve fifty seven (57) affordable housing units for a period of at least fifteen (15) years in a neighborhood whose residents are at greater risk of displacement.
candidates.wording: preserve fifty seven (57) affordable housing units
